author: MOHA_0
quote:
​The game was rebuilt from the ground up with gorgeous visuals and a silky-smooth 60fps, and best of all, they completely overhauled the controls adding manual jumping, a free camera, and quick item swapping without tedious menus. Paired with the orchestral soundtrack, voice acting in cutscenes, and awesome touches like playing the ocarina with the mic and the boss rush hall, it feels like a brand-new modern release while keeping all its classic charm and soul intact.

​The only thing missing right now is Master Quest. If Nintendo adds it down the line with its mirrored world and tougher puzzles, the experience would be 100% complete.

​Simply put, it’s a phenomenal experience and easily the best way to play one of the greatest games of all time.
game_title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
